ns2:course.label: Web Design Fundamentals
ns2:course.description: This course will teach students about building inclusive interactive systems. They will learn to gather and understand user requirements and needs for a wide range of user populations, especially those that are under-served (e.g., children, older adults, people with disabilities), apply inclusive design frameworks and principles, and design, develop, evaluate and improve interactive prototypes in an iterative manner. Prerequisite: IS 205, or IS 226, or equivalent course.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: IS 205, or IS 226, or equivalent course.
